name: Secrets Pointer
description: Stores an opaque pointer (URI, ARN, or vault path) to a secret in data records or configuration instead of embedding the secret value. The pointer is resolved at runtime by a secret manager that enforces access policy.
when_to_use: Secrets must travel through data pipelines without exposure
Centralized secret manager is the source of truth
Auditable per-record secret access is required
use_cases: Vault-stored API keys referenced from Kafka headers
Per-record encryption key pointers in data lake
External ID credentials in workflow DAGs
